method.disagreement_identification: Only dimensions on which the two supplied rater records differ are sent for adjudication; all 21 paired judgments must already be complete and source-linked.
method.adjudicator_inputs: A separately supplied third reader records an explicit binary judgment, case-specific mathematical justification, source actually inspected, self-attestation of conflicts and a pseudonym different from either rater.
method.analysis: Agreement and Cohen kappa remain the primary observed double-rating results. Adjudication does not rewrite them or count as evidence of instrument validity or an independent expert mathematical review.
method.privacy: Real participant text, rater reasoning and adjudicator responses must be kept in a private workspace outside the tracked MathOS repository and are never uploaded by protocol-only CI.
method.limitations: Human identity, participant consent, professional qualifications, conflicts of interest, statistical study validity and the correctness of mathematical arguments cannot be authenticated by this program.
